title: Not the best design
text: Not the best design. I bought two designs from this company. They have a very long zipper down the side (instead of just one short one at the top). The zipper puckers badly and does not lay nice. If you want to cuddle your pillow, you are stuck with the feel of this zipper. It's just not a great design feature. They took over 3 weeks to arrive. I will keep them but not buy again.
